current_date: Adopted November 2025 (council page: adopted 13th November 2025; applies to applications received after that date)
current_evidence: The council's 'What do I need to submit' page links it as 'Adopted Planning Application Checklist (PAVC): November 2025' and says 'The Council adopted the latest Validation Checklist on 13th November 2025'; the 2017 PAVC is labelled 'Superseded'. The only householder checklist linked is still the 1 June 2017 one.

issues.detail: Design and Access Statement is listed as a requirement under Advertisement, Change of use, Variation of conditions, Works to trees and Hazardous substances. The trigger excerpt Grokbot quotes is the exemption list, which says a DAS is NOT required for these application types.
issues.evidence: Trigger quoted by Grokbot: 'Design and Access Statements are not required for the following applications: permission to develop land without compliance with conditions... material change of use... advertisement consent... works to trees... storage of hazardous substances...'

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is placed under Householder, but the source excludes householder applications. It is also missing from Full planning, where it does apply within Coal Mining Development Referral Areas.
issues.evidence: C. Local Requirements, Coal Mining Risk Assessment: 'Required for all applications for development within Coal Mining Development Referral Areas excluding householder applications...'

issues.detail: Grokbot took several Full planning and Minerals & waste rows from the superseded 2017 PAVC (2017-Planning-Application-Validation-Checklist-1st-November-2017_0.pdf) instead of the November 2025 list. Examples are Block plan/Site plan, Design and Access Statement (also under Listed building), Employment/Economic Statement, Energy/Sustainability Statement, Landscaping scheme, Marketing/vacancy evidence and Contaminated Land (Minerals & waste). Several tab_items also come from it: the '3 working days' email text, the old pre-app text, the 'Policy NE5... July 2017' text and the 'taxi booking offices' plan.
issues.evidence: Council page link text: 'Superseded Planning Application Validation Checklist (PAVC): 2017'

issues.detail: Energy/Sustainability Statement uses a 2017 fragment ('over An Energy Statement should demonstrate...') that drops the current threshold. 'Water efficiency / water usage statement' is a generic energy-policy sentence presented as a separate requirement, but the source has no water-efficiency requirement.
issues.evidence: Energy Efficiency Statement 'Required for: All major applications for residential development; All non-residential development with a gross floorspace of 1000sqm or over'

issues.detail: Several Full planning rows are matched to the wrong text. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' and 'Photographs / Photomontages' quote the Appendix A bat survey checklist text and are not separate requirements. Viability Assessment quotes text about the Council's fees for reviewing viability, not the trigger. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' quotes the Construction Waste Management Plan (all major development), which is a separate item from the Refuse and Recycling Statement.
issues.evidence: Financial Viability Assessment is required where contributions would be contrary to Local Plan policies or the Developer Contributions SPD. Refuse and Recycling Statement: 'Required for all new dwellings and any development that will result in the need for refuse disposal.'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are cut off or garbled: Daylight/Sunlight ('impact on daylight or sunlight into habitable rooms or gardens/amenity space.'), 'Sunlight to gardens' ('or gardens/amenity space.') and LVIA ('of the LVIA 25 Validation Checklist November 2025 Further information/policy background...'). The LVIA trigger is residential, industrial or commercial development in the rural area, plus energy generation with significant landscape impact. Daylight/Sunlight is only 'Recommended', not required.
issues.evidence: Daylight/Sunlight Assessment: 'Recommended for applications that may cause significant issues of overshadowing'

issues.detail: These local requirements in the November 2025 list are not captured under Full planning: Heritage Statement (alter, demolish or extend a listed building or a building in a conservation area, etc.), Structural Survey (barn/historic conversions, substantial demolition of listed, locally listed or conservation area buildings; captured only under Listed building), Coal Mining Risk Assessment (Coal Mining Development Referral Areas, excluding householder), Public Rights of Way (all applications affecting a PRoW), Shop Front Details (new shop fronts and alterations), Summary of Application (supporting documents over 100 pages in total), SuDS Lancashire County Council Proforma (all major applications and wherever a Sustainable Drainage Strategy is required), Refuse and Recycling Statement (all new dwellings and any development needing refuse disposal) and Agricultural Needs Statement for agricultural buildings (Grokbot captured only the workers' dwelling part).
issues.evidence: C. Local Requirements, items 6, 14, 26, 27, 29, 31, 32, 33 of the November 2025 checklist

issues.detail: Grokbot put about 40 Full planning rows under that type on a guess ('INFERRED: application type not named...'). Examples are Air Quality, Archaeology, Fire Statement, Lighting, Telecommunications supplementary information and Mineral Resource Assessment. The source applies these by development characteristic, not to Full planning only, and Telecommunications applies to telecoms applications and prior approvals, not Full planning.
issues.evidence: Telecommunications Development Supplementary Information: 'Required for telecommunications applications and prior approvals'

issues.detail: Many tab_items are process text, links or fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'Submitting your application online and making payment electronically... MAX. file size of 10MB', 'Wherever possible we will seek to do this via email and within three working days', 'If a request for further information... not received within 21 days... WITHDRAWN', 'Copies of Notice 1 and Notice 2 are available...', 'R5318/3334 for pre-application enquiries' (phone-number fragment), 'Further information on the requirements of biodiversity Net Gain is available via: r_2024.pdf', the policy-reference lists ('Policy NE5 of Burnley's Local Plan...', 'Policies HS4, NE2, IC4 and IC5...'), 'Different types of application require different levels of information...' and the bare site names 'South Pennines Special Protection Area (SPA)...'.
issues.evidence: These are guidance and further-information text from Sections A and C, not 'Required for' items

issues.detail: Drawing-standard tab_items repeat the same text several times, mixing the 2025 list with the 2017 PAVC and householder checklist. Examples: 'Be drawn to a recognised metric scale, preferably at 1:50 or 1:100;' (several copies), 'Include written/annotated external dimensions of new buildings/extensions;' (twice), the 'All drawings must...' block (three versions, one garbled: 'All drawings drawingsmust: must: Be scale Be at at aarecognised...') and the Roof plans text (three copies).
The list date is recorded as 2025-11-01. The council states the checklist was adopted on 13 November 2025 and applies to applications received after that date.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'The Council adopted the latest Validation Checklist on 13th November 2025'

summary: The link is correct and current (adopted 13 Nov 2025), but Grokbot mixed in the superseded 2017 PAVC. It also placed the DAS under five application types the source exempts and put Coal Mining Risk Assessment under Householder, which the source excludes. Several current local requirements are missing, including Heritage Statement for full apps, Public Rights of Way, Shop Front Details, Summary of Application and the LCC SuDS proforma.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
